translation_notes: The site the stratifier flagged is `from ..namespace import KTBS, KTBS_NS_URI`: KTBS is ktbs/ktbs's own vocabulary object (lib/ktbs/namespace.py: a rdflib.namespace.ClosedNamespace over KTBS_NS_URI + '#', verified against the real file), used once in the region as `KTBS.hasTrace` -- genuinely ns_import_project, rewritten `from ktbs_namespace_context import KTBS_NS_URI, ktbs:` + `ktbs:hasTrace`. KTBS_NS_URI itself is used as a plain STRING (`"PREFIX ktbs: <%s#> %s" % (KTBS_NS_URI, select)`, building a raw SPARQL prologue by %-formatting), never as NS.attr -- stays a plain, non-prefixed import name, per declarations.md's mixed-list form.

RDF.type (`new_obs_graph.set((new_obs_uri, RDF.type, new_type))`) is rdflib's own namespace, not a project module -- @prefix rdf: + rdf:type, same split as every other region in this stratum. XSD (imported but never referenced anywhere in the region's body) is left as a plain, now-unused import, same discipline as BASE/DCTERMS in the sibling johnjung region -- not cleaned up.

`new_obs_graph.set(...)` is deliberately NOT rewritten to `+{ }`: rdflib's `Graph.set((s, p, o))` first REMOVES every existing (s, p, ?) triple before adding the new one (replace-the-single-value semantics), which `+{ }` does not do (pure add, INSTRUCTIONS_403's own +{ }-vs-.add() rule is about .add(), not .set()). The closed construction vocabulary has no set()-shaped island; substituting +{ } here would be exactly the kind of silent behaviour change (stale rdf:type triples surviving) INSTRUCTIONS_403 §2 warns against. Kept as plain rdflib, only its two namespace terms translated.

Restoring bindings (AGENT_BATCH's 163-regions case, the legitimate half): `import logging` was outside the extraction's context window (verified against the real file, hrules.py line 20 -- LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__) is carried but the import above it was not) and is added back in original.py/translated.ldpy identically. The `..namespace` relative import is swapped for ktbs_namespace_context.py the same way as every other region in this stratum needing a project-owned namespace shim (module path changed, names untouched).
